snippet.title: Bulbo's Belief System release date trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

Bulbo's Belief System by Abstract Digital is releasing November 2026!

Bulbo's Belief System in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/bulbos-belief-system/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549280/Bulbos_Belief_System/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
